draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Following up on my note last week — no reply needed if things are moving along fine.

If it's still on the to-do list, the usual first step is getting a project set up: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
